info.summary: HTTP API of rivulet-engine, a drop-in for Stremio's streaming server (server.js).
info.description: HTTP API served by rivulet-engine, a pure-Go drop-in for Stremio's streaming server (server.js) on port 11470. The API has no authentication: any process that can reach the port is trusted. Browser requests carrying an `Origin` header are checked against an allowlist (`RIVULET_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` plus built-in Stremio web and localhost defaults) before any route runs and are refused with 403 otherwise. `serverVersion` is reported as 4.21.0 for client feature-gating; it is independent of the binary build version.

get.description: Resolves the archive (download or confined local path), lists it and selects the default entry (fileIdx, then fileMustInclude, then largest video, then largest file). GET answers a 307 redirect to `/7zip/stream/{key}/{selectedEntry}`. Any method other than POST is treated as GET (redirect). The payload is read from `?lz=` or the request body (up to 4 MiB); with neither -> 400 `empty payload`. A caller-supplied `{key}` makes the create idempotent: an equivalent payload reuses the live session. All error bodies are text/plain (http.Error).

parameters.name: lz
parameters.description: lz-string (compressToEncodedURIComponent) compressed JSON payload; takes precedence over the request body. Encoded limit 1 MiB.

307.description: Redirect to the stream URL of the selected entry

400.description: Bad payload: empty payload, lz decode error / too large, invalid JSON, missing url/from, or local path not found/not permitted (`local path not found`)

422.description: Archive could not be opened/listed (`open archive: …`, `list archive: …`) or contains no files

500.description: Session allocation failed (`mkdirtemp: …`) or build aborted

502.description: Download of the archive source failed (`download failed: …`, includes SSRF-guard rejections of private hosts)

get.description: Always served (even when the indexer is not configured).

Queries a self-hosted Bitmagnet GraphQL index (`RIVULET_BITMAGNET_URL`; unset -> always empty `streams`). Title/year are resolved via the metadata add-on (Cinemeta). Results are filtered by content type and, for series, by season/episode, sorted by seeders and capped at 20. Route as served: `/bitmagnet/stream/{type}/{id}.json` (the `.json` suffix is optional; extra trailing segments are ignored).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Content type; only `movie` and `series` produce results, anything else yields an empty list.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: IMDB id (`tt…`); for series `tt…:season:episode`. A trailing `.json` is stripped by the server.

200.description: Streams (empty array when not configured, unsupported type, or upstream failure — upstream errors are logged and never surfaced)

get.summary: Resolve a hoster page into a proxied stream (MediaFlow-compatible)
get.description: `name` must be `video`, `video.m3u8` or `video.mp4` (all equivalent); any other name -> 404. Extractor definitions come from the extractors file/URL; an unknown `host` is a 400. With `redirect_stream=true` the client is 302-redirected to the matching `/proxy/...` URL, otherwise MediaFlow's JSON description is returned. JSON errors use the key `detail`; auth errors are text/plain.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Endpoint name

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Extractor name from extractors.json (case-insensitive)

parameters.name: d
parameters.description: Hoster page URL, plain or base64 encoded

parameters.name: redirect_stream
parameters.description: `true` (Go ParseBool) to 302 to the proxy URL instead of returning JSON

parameters.name: proxy
parameters.description: Per-request upstream proxy URL (schemes socks5, socks5h, http, https; anything else is silently ignored). Host is SSRF-guarded (403 when blocked).

parameters.name: api_password
parameters.description: Proxy password (`RIVULET_PROXY_PASSWORD`); checked only when a password is configured. Ignored when a valid `token` is supplied and a signing secret is configured.

ArchiveCreatePayload.description: Archive create payload (JSON body, or the same JSON lz-string-compressed with compressToEncodedURIComponent in `?lz=`; `?lz=` wins over the body). May also be sent as a one-element array of this object (only the first element is used). `url`, `from` and `urls[0]` are synonyms for the archive source; precedence url, then from, then urls. http(s) sources are downloaded; any other value is a local path, honoured only when the server has a local archive root configured (otherwise 400 `local path not found`). Multiple `urls` entries with an http first entry are downloaded and joined as multi-part archives.

url.description: Archive source (http(s) URL or local path).

urls.description: stremio-core form: entries are `[url, bytes?]` tuples (also tolerated: bare URL strings or {url} objects).

Command is resolved from the path suffix, then `command`, then inferred (source:null->stop, source->load, subtitlesSrc/subtitlesDelay->subtitles, stop->stop, paused:true->pause, time->seek, else status). Numbers/booleans are stringified; other JSON types (arrays/objects) are ignored.

source.description: Media URL (http/https only) for load; null means stop.

time.description: load: resume position in milliseconds (optional); seek: target in seconds (0..360000).

from.description: http:// or https:// URL of a .torrent file (other schemes -> 400; private/loopback targets -> 403)

sources.description: `tracker:<url>` entries add trackers; `dht:` entries are ignored

endpoint.description: Proxy path a token is issued for: `/proxy/stream`, `/proxy/ip`, or a path starting `/proxy/hls/`, `/proxy/mpd/`, `/proxy/stream/` (no `?#\` or space)

params.description: Query params sealed into the token; `d`, if present, must decode to an http(s) URL
